title: Client-rendered directory needing clicks

steps.post: @{agent} open {FIX}/client-rendered-directory.html and list every faculty member whose office is in the Sherman Health Science Centre, with each one's extension. The listing shows five people at a time; check every page.

groundTruth.note: The roster is built by script; a plain fetch sees no table. The raw source does hold the data in a script block, so a reply built from web::fetch alone can still be correct.

pass: Exactly these four people with these four extensions; no one missing, no one added.

checks.text: The page was driven with web::navigate and web::click on the Next control through to the last page. If the data came from the raw source via web::fetch instead, mark n/a and record it as an observation.
Every name and extension in the reply appears in a snapshot or page the turn read.
